title.zh: 卷三十八 唐書14: 明宗本紀四
title.en: Volume 38 Book of Later Tang 14: Mingzong Annals 4
title.raw: 卷三十八 唐書14: 明宗本紀四 Volume 38 Book of Later Tang 14: Mingzong Annals 4

sentences.zh: 天成二年春正月癸丑朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如常儀。

translations.literal: In spring, first month of Tiancheng 2, on the guichou new moon the Emperor held audience at the Bright Hall; guards and escort followed the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the first month of Tiancheng 2 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with the usual guard.

sentences.zh: 製曰：「王者祗敬宗祧，統臨寰宇，必順體元之典，特新製義之文。

translations.literal: A proclamation said: "The king reverently honors the ancestral temples and rules all within the four seas; he must follow the rites of embodying the origin and specially renew the text of proclamation and meaning.
translations.idiomatic: A proclamation said the throne must honor the ancestral temples, rule the realm, follow founding rites, and renew the proclamation's wording.

sentences.zh: 朕以眇躬，獲承丕構，襲三百年之休運，繼二十聖之耿光。

translations.literal: I, with this slight person, have received the great structure, inherited three hundred years of felicitous fortune, and continued the bright glory of twenty sage rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said he had inherited three centuries of good fortune and the light of twenty sage emperors.

sentences.zh: 馭朽納隍，夕惕之心罔怠；

translations.literal: Steering a decaying vessel and filling the moat, the heart of evening vigilance never slackens;
translations.idiomatic: He steered a failing state and never slackened his evening vigil;

sentences.zh: 法天師古，日躋之道惟勤。

translations.literal: modeling Heaven and taking antiquity as teacher, the way of daily ascent lies only in diligence.
translations.idiomatic: he modeled Heaven, followed antiquity, and advanced only through diligence.

sentences.zh: 今則載戢干戈，渾同書軌，荷上穹之眷祐，契兆庶之樂推。

translations.literal: Now weapons are stored and writing and wheels are unified; I bear Heaven's favor and accord with the people's willing acclaim.
translations.idiomatic: Weapons were stilled, the realm unified, Heaven favored him, and the people acclaimed him.

sentences.zh: 檢玉泥金，非敢期於薄德；

translations.literal: Sealing jade and smearing gold—I dare not expect this from slight virtue;
translations.idiomatic: He dared not claim jade-seal and gold-inscription rites beyond his merit;

sentences.zh: 耕田鑿井，誠有慕於前王。

translations.literal: plowing fields and digging wells—I truly emulate the former kings.
translations.idiomatic: yet he truly wished to plow and dig wells like the ancient kings.

sentences.zh: 將陳享謁之儀，即備郊丘之禮，宜更稱謂，永耀簡編。

translations.literal: I shall display the rites of offering and audience and forthwith prepare the suburban mound ceremonies; the appellation should be changed and forever shine in the annals.
translations.idiomatic: Before suburban rites he would change his title so it would shine in the records.

sentences.zh: 今改名為亶，凡在中外，宜體朕懷。

translations.literal: Herewith the name is changed to Dan; all within and without should embody my intent.
translations.idiomatic: His name was changed to Dan, and court and realm were asked to heed his intent.

sentences.zh: 」宣製訖，百僚稱賀，有司告郊廟社稷。

translations.literal: " When the proclamation had been announced, the hundred officials offered congratulations, and the relevant offices notified the suburban shrines, ancestral temple, and altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: " After the proclamation, officials congratulated him and the ritual offices notified the suburban shrines.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔：「端明殿學士班位宜在翰林學士之上，今後如有轉改，隻於翰林學士內選任。

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict said: "Duanming Hall academicians' court rank should be above Hanlin academicians; hereafter if there is transfer or promotion, selection shall be made only from among Hanlin academicians.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Mingzong ordered Duanming Hall scholars to rank above Hanlin and future appointees to come from Hanlin alone.

sentences.zh: 」先是，端明殿學士班在翰林學士之下，又如三館例，官在職上，趙鳳轉侍郎日，諷宰相府移之。

translations.literal: " Earlier Duanming Hall academicians ranked below Hanlin academicians; as with the Three Institutes precedent, when the office was above the post, on the day Zhao Feng was transferred to Vice Director he urged the chancellery to move it.
translations.idiomatic: " Duanming had ranked below Hanlin until Zhao Feng, as vice director, pressed the chancellery to raise it, following Three Institutes precedent.

sentences.zh: 既而禁林序列有不可之言，安重誨奏行此敕，時論便之。

translations.literal: Soon there were objections in the forbidden-grove sequence; An Chonghui memorialized to enact this edict, and contemporary opinion approved it.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin objected, but An Chonghui had the edict enacted and opinion approved.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，宰臣鄭玨加特進、門下侍郎兼太微宮使；

translations.literal: On guihai Grand Councillor Zheng Jue was given extraordinary advance, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and concurrent commissioner of the Taiwei Palace;
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zheng Jue received extraordinary advance, vice director, and Taiwei Palace commissioner.

sentences.zh: 崇文館大學士任圜加光祿大夫、門下侍郎、監修國史；

translations.literal: Grand Academician of the Chongwen Hall Ren Yuan was given Grandee of Splendid Happiness, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and overseer of the national history;
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yuan of Chongwen Hall became grandee, vice director, and overseer of national history;

sentences.zh: 以端明殿學士、尚書兵部侍郎馮道為中書侍郎、平章事、集賢殿大學士；

translations.literal: Duanming Hall academician and Vice Director of the Ministry of War Feng Dao was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councillor, and Grand Academician of the Jixian Hall;
translations.idiomatic: Feng Dao became Zhongshu vice director, grand councillor, and Jixian grand academician;

sentences.zh: 以太常卿崔協為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Sacrifices Cui Xie was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: and Cui Xie, grand minister of sacrifices, became vice director and grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前鄧州節度使劉玘卒，廢朝。

translations.literal: On wuchen, because former Dengzhou military commissioner Liu Qi had died, court attendance was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen court was canceled for the death of former Deng commissioner Liu Qi.

sentences.zh: 左拾遺李同上言：「天下係囚，請委長吏逐旬親自引問，質其罪狀真虛，然後論之以法，庶無枉濫。

translations.literal: Left Remembrancer Li Tong submitted: "Prisoners held throughout the realm—please commission chief officials each ten-day period personally to lead questioning, ascertain whether charges are true or false, and only then apply the law, so that there may be no wrongful excess.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tong asked that local chiefs question prisoners every ten days and judge only after verifying charges, to curb wrongful convictions.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 辛未，皇子河中節度使從珂加同平章事。

translations.literal: On xinwei the prince, Hezhong military commissioner Li Congke, was given concurrent Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Congke of Hezhong received concurrent grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 以鎮州留後、檢校司徒王建立為鎮州節度使、檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Zhenzhou regent and Grand Preceptor by inspection Wang Jianli was made Zhenzhou military commissioner and Grand Preceptor by inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jianli, Zhen regent, became Zhen commissioner and grand preceptor by inspection.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，第三子金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒從厚加檢校太保、同平章事、河南尹，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On guiyou the third son, Grandee of Splendid Happiness and Grand Preceptor by inspection Li Conghou, was given Grand Guardian by inspection, concurrent Grand Councillor, Henan intendant, and charge over the Six Armies and all guards.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Conghou became grand guardian and grand councillor, Henan intendant, and judge of the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 北面副招討房知溫奏，營州界奚陀羅支內附。

translations.literal: Northern vice campaign commissioner Fang Zhiwen memorialized that within Yingzhou's border the Xi chieftain Tuoluozhi had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zhiwen reported Xi Tuoluozhi had submitted at the Yingzhou border.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以監門衛大將軍傅璉為右武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On yihai Monitor Gate Guard senior general Fu Lian was made senior general of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Fu Lian of the monitor gate guard became right martial guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：「頃自本朝多難，雅道中微，皆尚浮華，罕持廉讓。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict said: "Lately since this dynasty's many troubles the proper way has declined; all prize flash and show, and few hold integrity and yielding.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict lamented that since the dynasty's troubles officials prized display over integrity.

sentences.zh: 其有除官蘭省，命秩柏台，或以人事相疏，或以私讎見訝，稍乖敬奉，遽至棄捐，蓋司長之振威，處君恩而何地。

translations.literal: Those who receive office in the orchid hall or rank on the cypress terrace may be estranged by personnel matters or offended by private feud; if they slightly miss respectful service they are forthwith cast aside—is this section chiefs flexing authority, and where is there room for sovereign grace?
translations.idiomatic: Orchid Hall and censorate appointees were cast aside over slights or feuds—section chiefs flexing power with no room for grace.

sentences.zh: 今後應新授官朝謝後，可準例上事，司長不得輒以私事阻滯。

translations.literal: Hereafter newly appointed officials, after court thanks, may report for duty per precedent; section chiefs must not on private grounds obstruct them.
translations.idiomatic: New appointees could report after court thanks; chiefs could not block them on private grounds.

sentences.zh: 其本官亦不得因遭抑挫，托故請假。」

translations.literal: Their original office also may not, because of suppression, use pretext to request leave."
translations.idiomatic: Nor could their home office use suppression as an excuse for leave."

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇子從厚領事於河南府，宰相鄭玨已下會送，非例也。

translations.literal: On wuyin the prince Conghou took charge at Henan prefecture; Grand Councillor Zheng Jue and below went out to see him off—without precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Conghou took Henan; Zheng Jue and other chancellors saw him off, which was unprecedented.

sentences.zh: 己卯，樞密使、光祿大夫、檢校太保、行兵部尚書安重誨加開府儀同三司、檢校太傅、兼侍中；

translations.literal: On jimao Privy Commissioner, Grandee of Splendid Happiness, Grand Guardian by inspection, and acting Minister of War An Chonghui was given Kaifu Yitong Sansi, Grand Preceptor by inspection, and concurrent Attendance Master;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao An Chonghui received Kaifu Yitong, grand preceptor by inspection, and attendance master;

sentences.zh: 樞密使、檢校太保、守秘書監孔循加檢校太傅、同平章事。

translations.literal: Privy Commissioner, Grand Guardian by inspection, and acting Supervisor of the Secretariat Kong Xun was given Grand Preceptor by inspection and concurrent Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: and Kong Xun received grand preceptor by inspection and concurrent grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 詔崇文館依舊為宏文館。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Chongwen Hall restored to the former Hongwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong restored the Chongwen Hall to its former name Hongwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 初，同光中，宰相豆盧革以同列郭崇韜父名宏，希其意奏改之，今乃復焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Tongguang era, Grand Councillor Dou Lu'ge, because his colleague Guo Chongtao's father's name was Hong, to please his intent memorialized to change it; now it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongguang Dou Lu'ge had renamed it to please Guo Chongtao's father's taboo Hong; now the old name returned.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔曰：「亂離斯久，法制多隳，不有舉明，從何禁止。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict said: "Disorder and separation have lasted long and statutes are largely ruined; without clear proclamation, from what shall prohibition proceed?
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict said long disorder had ruined law and must be clarified to enforce it.

sentences.zh: 起今後三京及州使職員名目，是押衙兵馬使，騎馬得有暖坐。

translations.literal: From now on, among staff titles in the three capitals and on commissioners' staffs, those who are ya-ya or army-and-horse commissioners may ride with a warmed seat.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners' ya-ya and army commissioners in the capitals might ride with warmed saddles.

sentences.zh: 諸都軍將衙官使下係名糧者，隻得衣紫皂，庶人商旅，隻著白衣，此後不得參雜。

translations.literal: Staff on the roster under army generals and commissioners' offices may wear only purple or black; commoners and traveling merchants may wear only white—hereafter they must not be mixed.
translations.idiomatic: Army staff on roster wore purple or black only; commoners and merchants white only—no mixing.

sentences.zh: 兼有富戶，或投名於勢要，以求影庇；

translations.literal: Moreover wealthy households sometimes enroll their names with the powerful to seek shadow protection;
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy households also enrolled with the powerful for protection;

sentences.zh: 或希假於攝貴，以免丁徭。

translations.literal: or hope to borrow a great man's name to avoid corvée and levies.
translations.idiomatic: or borrowed great men's names to escape corvée.

sentences.zh: 仰所在禁勘，以肅奸欺。」

translations.literal: Let every locality prohibit and investigate, to purge fraud."
translations.idiomatic: Localities were ordered to investigate and purge such fraud."

sentences.zh: 二月壬午朔，新羅遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Second month, renwu new moon: Silla sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the second month Silla sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以北京皇城使李繼朗為龍武大將軍，北京都指揮使李從臻為左衛大將軍，捧聖都指揮使李從璨為右監門衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai northern capital inner-city commissioner Li Jilang was made senior general of the Dragon Martial Guard; northern capital overall commander Li Congzhen was made senior general of the Left Guard; Pingsheng overall commander Li Congcan was made senior general of the Right Monitor Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Jilang became dragon martial senior general, Li Congzhen left guard senior general, and Li Congcan right monitor gate senior general.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以前北面水陸轉運招撫使、守冀州刺史烏震領宣州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuzi former northern land-and-water transport and pacification commissioner and acting Ji prefect Wu Zhen was made Xuancheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Wu Zhen, former northern transport commissioner, became Xu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，陝州節度使、檢校司徒石敬瑭加檢校太傅兼六軍諸衛副使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Shaan military commissioner and Grand Preceptor by inspection Shi Jingtang was given Grand Preceptor by inspection and concurrent deputy of the Six Armies and all guards.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Shi Jingtang of Shaan became grand preceptor by inspection and Six Armies deputy.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，西川節度使孟知祥奏，泗州防禦使、充西川兵馬都監李嚴，扇搖軍眾，尋已處斬。

translations.literal: On renchen Western River military commissioner Meng Zhixiang memorialized that Sizhou defense commissioner and Western River army-and-horse overseer Li Yan had incited the troops and had already been executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Meng Zhixiang reported Sizhou defender Li Yan had stirred the army and been executed.

sentences.zh: 以潁州刺史孫嶽為耀州團練使。

translations.literal: Ying prefect Sun Yue was made Yaozhou training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yue became Yao training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以從馬直指揮使郭從謙為景州刺史，尋令中使誅之，夷其族，以其首謀大逆以弑莊宗也。

translations.literal: On bingshen Congma Direct commander Guo Congqian was made Jing prefect; soon a palace envoy was ordered to execute him and exterminate his clan, because as chief plotter he had murdered Zhuangzong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Guo Congqian became Jing prefect, then a eunuch executed him and exterminated his clan for leading Zhuangzong's murder.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左丞崔沂為太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Cui Yi was made crown prince junior mentor and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yi retired as crown prince junior mentor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，製曰：荊南節度使、開府儀同三司、守太尉、兼尚書令、南平王高季興可削奪官爵，仍令襄州節度使劉訓充南面招討使、知荊南行府事，許州節度使夏魯奇為副招討使，統蕃漢馬步四萬人進討，以其叛故也。

translations.literal: On renyin a proclamation said: Jingnan military commissioner, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Minister-in-Chief, and Prince of Nanping Gao Jixing may be stripped of office and rank; moreover Li Xun, Xiang military commissioner, is appointed southern campaign commissioner and acting Jingnan headquarters commissioner; Xu military commissioner Xia Luqi is deputy campaign commissioner; with four ten thousand Han and barbarian horse and foot they advance to punish him—for his rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Mingzong stripped Gao Jixing of rank and ordered Liu Xun of Xiang as southern campaign commissioner with Xia Luqi as deputy and forty thousand troops to punish his rebellion.

sentences.zh: 又命湖南節度使馬殷以湖南全軍會合。

translations.literal: He also ordered Hunan military commissioner Ma Yin to unite with Hunan's full army.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yin of Hunan was told to bring his full army.

sentences.zh: 以東川節度使董璋充東南面招討使，新授夔州刺史西方鄴為副招討使，共領川軍下峽州，三面齊進。

translations.literal: Eastern River military commissioner Dong Zhang was made southeastern campaign commissioner; newly appointed Kuizhou prefect Xi Fangye was deputy campaign commissioner; together they led Sichuan troops down through Qiazhou—three faces advancing together.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhang led the eastern face from Sichuan with Xi Fangye of Kuizhou as deputy while three columns converged.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒考異》：梓、夔皆在荊南之西南，而雲東南面者，蓋據夔、梓所向言之。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian · Textual Notes》: Zi and Kui are both southwest of Jingnan; yet it says southeastern because it speaks from the direction of Kui and Zi.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian · Textual Notes》 says Zi and Kui lie southwest of Jingnan but the text says southeast from their approach.)〉

sentences.zh: 甲辰，兗州節度使房知溫加同平章事，宋州節度使王晏球加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On jiachen Yan military commissioner Fang Zhiwen was given concurrent Grand Councillor; Song military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was given Grand Preceptor by inspection.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Fang Zhiwen of Yan became grand councillor and Wang Yanqiu of Song grand preceptor by inspection.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以禮部尚書蕭頃為太常卿。

translations.literal: On dingwei Minister of Rites Xiao Xiang was made Grand Minister of Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xiao Xiang became grand minister of sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以御史大夫李琪為右僕射，以太子賓客李鈴為戶部尚書，以吏部侍郎李德休為禮部尚書，以前吏部侍即崔貽孫為吏部侍郎，以端明殿學士、戶部侍郎趙鳳為兵部侍郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: On wushen Censor-in-Chief Li Qi was made Right Vice Director; crown prince guest Li Ling was made Minister of Revenue; Vice Director of Rites Li Dexiu was made Minister of Rites; former Vice Director of Personnel Cui Yisun was made Vice Director of Personnel; Duanming Hall academician and Vice Director of Revenue Zhao Feng was made Vice Director of War, continuing in his former charge.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Qi became right vice director, Li Ling revenue minister, Li Dexiu rites minister, Cui Yisun personnel vice director, and Zhao Feng war vice director while keeping his old duties.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔諸道節度使男及親嫡骨肉未沾恩命者，特許上聞。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict said that for sons of military commissioners of every circuit and close collateral kin not yet favored with appointments, special permission is granted to report upward.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu commissioners' sons and close kin without appointments might petition for favor.

sentences.zh: 河南府新安縣宜為次赤，以雍陵在其界故也。

translations.literal: Xin'an county of Henan prefecture should be made secondary red, because the Yong mausoleum lies within its border.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's Xin'an was raised to secondary red because Yong mausoleum lay within it.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以刑部侍郎歸藹為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: On xinhai Vice Director of Punishments Gui Ai was made Vice Director of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Gui Ai moved from punishments to revenue vice director.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，以中書舍人馬縞為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, renzi new moon: Secretariat drafter Ma Gao was made Vice Director of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon Ma Gao became punishments vice director.

sentences.zh: 幸會節園，宰相、樞密使及在京節度使共進錢絹，請開宴。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the Festival Garden; Grand Councillors, privy commissioners, and military commissioners in the capital together presented cash and silk and asked that a banquet be opened.
translations.idiomatic: At the Festival Garden chancellors, privy commissioners, and capital commissioners presented cash and silk and asked for a banquet.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣供奉官賈俊使淮南。

translations.literal: On guichou tribute commissioner Jia Jun was sent to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Jia Jun was sent to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以西川節度副使李敬周為遂州武信軍留後。

translations.literal: On jiazi Western River military vice commissioner Li Jingzhou was made Wuxin army regent at Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Li Jingzhou became Suizhou Wuxin regent.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，開府儀同三司、司徒致仕趙光逢可太保致仕，仍封齊國公。

translations.literal: Kaifu Yitong Sansi, Grand Preceptor retired Zhao Guangfeng may be Grand Guardian retired, and still enfeoffed Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Guangfeng retired from grand preceptor to grand guardian and was enfeoffed Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 以武信軍節度使李紹文卒廢朝。

translations.literal: Because Wuxin army military commissioner Li Shaowen had died, court attendance was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Court was canceled for the death of Li Shaowen of Wuxin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，宰臣判三司任圜奏：「諸道藩府，請依天復三年已前許貢綾絹金銀，隨其土產折進馬之直。

translations.literal: On bingchen Grand Councillor in charge of the Three Offices Ren Yuan memorialized: "On every circuit and garrison, please permit tribute of silk, gold, and silver as before Tianfu 3, converted from local products at horse value.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Ren Yuan asked circuits to resume Tianfu 3-style silk and silver tribute in lieu of horses by local product value.

sentences.zh: 又請選孳生馬，分置監牧。

translations.literal: He also asked to select breeding horses and place them in supervisory herds by allotment.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to breed horses in supervisory herds.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " Both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong approved both requests.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：任圜奏：三京留守、諸道節度觀察、諸州防禦使、刺史，每年應聖節及正、至等節貢奉，或討伐勝捷，各進獻馬。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: Ren Yuan memorialized: Three-capital regents, military commissioners and observers of every circuit, and defense commissioners and prefects of every prefecture each year at imperial festivals and the winter and summer solstices presented tribute, or after victorious campaigns presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 quotes Ren Yuan: commissioners and prefects yearly presented horses at festivals or after victories.

sentences.zh: 伏見本朝舊事，雖以獻馬為名，多將綾絹金銀折充馬價，蓋跋涉之際，護養稍難，因此群方俱為定制。

translations.literal: We observe the old affairs of this dynasty: though the presentation was in the name of horses, mostly silk, gold, and silver were converted to cover horse price, because on long journeys protection and upkeep are somewhat difficult—hence all regions alike made it a fixed practice.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute had long been silk and silver converted to horse price because long transport was hard, so all regions followed the custom.

sentences.zh: 自今後伏乞除蕃部進駝馬外，諸州所進馬，許依天復三年已前事例，隨其土產折進價直，冀貢輸之稍易，又誠敬之獲申。

translations.literal: From now we beg that except for barbarian camel and horse tribute, for horses presented by every prefecture the Tianfu 3 precedent may be followed, converting from local products at value, so that tribute may be somewhat easier and sincere respect still obtained.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that except for barbarian camels and horses, prefectures might again convert local goods per Tianfu 3 to ease tribute while keeping respect.

sentences.zh: 兼欲於諸處揀孳生馬，準舊制分置監牧，仍委三司使別具製置奏聞。）〉

translations.literal: We also wish to select breeding horses everywhere, place supervisory herds by old rule in allotments, and still charge the Three Offices commissioner separately to memorialize regulations.)〉
translations.idiomatic: He also wanted breeding herds restored and the Three Offices to set rules.)〉

sentences.zh: 太常丞段顒請國學《五經》博士各講本經，以申橫經齒胄之義，從之。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Sacrifices Duan Hao asked that each of the Five Classics doctors at the National University expound his classic, to fulfill the meaning of crosswise classics and helmeted heirs; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Hao asked each National University Five Classics doctor to lecture his text; Mingzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前澤潞節度使、檢校太傅、兼侍中孔為河陽節度使。

translations.literal: On gengshen former Zelu military commissioner, Grand Preceptor by inspection, and concurrent Attendance Master Kong Wei was made Heyang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Kong Wei of Zelu became Heyang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸甘水亭。

translations.literal: On renxu the Emperor visited Sweetwater Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Mingzong visited Sweetwater Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 甲子，青州節度使霍彥威加檢校太尉、兼中書令，以大內皇城使、守饒州刺史李從璋為應州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiazi Qing military commissioner Huo Yanwei was given Grand Preceptor by inspection and concurrent Minister-in-Chief; inner-city commissioner and acting Rao prefect Li Congzhang was made Yingzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Huo Yanwei of Qing became grand preceptor and minister-in-chief, and Li Congzhang became Ying commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔：「所在府縣糾察殺牛賣肉，犯者準條科斷。

translations.literal: On dingmao an edict said: "In every prefecture and county investigate and restrain the slaughter and sale of cattle; violators shall be punished by statute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Mingzong ordered counties to punish illegal cattle slaughter and sale.

sentences.zh: 其自死牛即許貨賣，肉斤不得過五錢，鄉村民家死牛，但報本村所由，準例輸皮入官。

translations.literal: Cattle that died naturally may be sold; meat per jin may not exceed five cash; village households' dead cattle need only report to the local headman and, per precedent, deliver hides to the government.
translations.idiomatic: Natural deaths might be sold at no more than five cash per jin; villagers reported dead cattle and paid hides to the state.

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，以戶部郎中、知制誥盧詹為中書舍人。

translations.literal: " On guiyou Revenue bureau director and edict drafter Lu Zhan was made Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: " On guiyou Lu Zhan became secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳朔，房知溫奏：「前月二十一日，盧台戍軍亂，害副招討寧國軍節度使烏震，尋與安審通斬殺亂兵訖。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinsi new moon: Fang Zhiwen memorialized: "On the twenty-first of last month the Lutai garrison troops mutinied and killed vice campaign commissioner and Ningguo military commissioner Wu Zhen; soon with An Shentong they beheaded the mutinous troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the fourth month Fang Zhiwen reported Lutai mutineers had killed Wu Zhen on the twenty-first of last month and he and An Shentong had beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 」帝聞之，廢朝一日，贈震太傅。

translations.literal: " When the Emperor heard it, he suspended court one day and gave Wu Zhen posthumous Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong canceled court one day and posthumously made Wu Zhen grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 新羅國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: The state of Silla sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Silla sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以華州留後劉彥琮為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On dinghai Hua regent Liu Yancong was made military commissioner of that army.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Liu Yancong of Hua received full commissionership.

sentences.zh: 是日，幸會節園宴近臣。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor visited the Festival Garden and banqueted close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: That day Mingzong banqueted close ministers at the Festival Garden.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以兵部侍郎崔居儉權知尚書左丞，以戶部侍郎王權為兵部侍郎，以禮部侍郎裴皞為戶部侍郎，以翰林承旨、守中書舍人李愚為禮部侍郎充職。

translations.literal: On jichou Vice Director of War Cui Jujian was made acting Left Vice Director; Vice Director of Revenue Wang Quan was made Vice Director of War; Vice Director of Rites Pei Hao was made Vice Director of Revenue; Hanlin chief drafter and acting Secretariat drafter Li Yu was made Vice Director of Rites in his charge.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Cui Jujian acted as left vice director, Wang Quan became war vice director, Pei Hao revenue vice director, and Li Yu rites vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，御史台奏：「今月三日廊下餐，百官坐定，兩省官方來，自五品下輒起。

translations.literal: On gengyin the Censorate memorialized: "At this month's third-day corridor meal, when the hundred officials were seated, the two departments' officials only then arrived; from fifth rank down they rose at once.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Censorate said that at the third-day corridor meal lower officials had risen before the two departments arrived.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「每赴廊餐，如對禦宴，若行私禮，是失朝儀，各罰半月俸。」

translations.literal: " An edict said: "Whenever attending corridor meals, it is as facing an imperial banquet; if private rites are performed, court ritual is lost—each is fined half a month's salary."
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong fined each offender half a month's salary for private rites at a court meal."

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：長興三年五月詔：文武兩班，每遇入閣賜食，從前御史台官及諸朝官皆在敷政門外兩廊食，惟北省官於敷政門內別坐，既為隔門，各不相見，致行坐不齊，難於肅整。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: Changxing 3, fifth month edict: whenever civil and military cohorts received food on entering the hall, formerly censorate officials and all court officials ate in the two corridors outside Fuzheng Gate, while only northern-department officials sat separately inside Fuzheng Gate; already separated by the gate and not seeing one another, seating and standing were not aligned and hard to keep in order.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 cites a Changxing 3 edict: northern and southern officials had eaten on opposite sides of Fuzheng Gate, breaking formation.

sentences.zh: 今後每遇入閣賜食，北省官亦宜於敷政門外東廓下設席，以北首為上，待班齊一時就坐。）〉

translations.literal: Hereafter whenever food is given on entering the hall, northern-department officials also should set seats in the east corridor outside Fuzheng Gate, with north as upper; when the cohort is aligned they take their seats together.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth northern officials would sit in the east corridor outside the gate, north foremost, and dine together when aligned.)〉

sentences.zh: 詔：「盧台亂軍龍至所部鄴都奉節等九指揮三千五百人在營家口骨肉，並可全家處斬。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Among the Lutai mutinous troops, the nine commands Fengjie and the rest under Long Zhi—three thousand five hundred men in camp with dependents—may all be executed, whole families.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong ordered whole families of Long Zhi's nine Fengjie commands—3,500 men with dependents—executed.

sentences.zh: 」龍至所部之眾，即梁故魏博節度使楊師厚之所招置也，皆天下雄勇之士，目其都為銀槍效節，僅八千人。

translations.literal: " The troops under Long Zhi were those Yang Shihou of Liang, former Weibo military commissioner, had recruited—all the realm's fiercest warriors; their command was called Silver Spear Obedient Service, barely eight thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: " Long Zhi's men were Yang Shihou's Weibo recruits, called the Silver Spear Obedient Service—eight thousand of the realm's fiercest troops.

sentences.zh: 師厚卒，賀德倫不能制，西迎莊宗入魏，從征河上，所向有功。

translations.literal: When Shihou died, He Delun could not control them; they went west to welcome Zhuangzong into Wei and followed the campaign on the Yellow River, achieving merit wherever they went.
translations.idiomatic: After Yang Shihou died He Delun lost control; they welcomed Zhuangzong into Wei and fought well on the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 莊宗一統之後，雖數頒賚，而驕縱無厭。

translations.literal: After Zhuangzong unified the realm, though rewards were repeatedly bestowed, they were arrogant and insatiable.
translations.idiomatic: After unification Zhuangzong rewarded them often, yet they grew arrogant and greedy.

sentences.zh: 同光末，自貝州劫趙在禮，據有魏博。

translations.literal: At the end of Tongguang they raided Bei with Zhao Zaili and held Weibo.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Tongguang they joined Zhao Zaili at Bei and seized Weibo.

sentences.zh: 及帝纘位，在禮冀脫其禍，潛奏願赴朝覲，遂除皇子從榮為帥，乃令北禦契丹。

translations.literal: When the Emperor succeeded to the throne, Zaili hoped to escape disaster and secretly memorialized wishing to come to court; the prince Congrong was therefore made commander, then ordered north to guard against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong succeeded, Zhao Zaili sought court to escape blame; Congrong was made commander and sent north against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 是行也，不支甲胄，惟幟於長竿表隊伍而已，故俯首遄征。

translations.literal: On that campaign they wore no armor—only banners on long poles marked the ranks—so they bowed their heads and marched swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: They wore no armor, only long-pole banners, and marched quickly.

sentences.zh: 在途聞李嚴為孟知祥所害，以為劍南阻絕，互相煽動。

translations.literal: On the road they heard Li Yan had been killed by Meng Zhixiang and thought Sword South was cut off and were mutually inciting one another.
translations.idiomatic: En route they heard Meng Zhixiang had killed Li Yan, thought Sichuan was cut off, and stirred one another.

sentences.zh: 及屯於盧台，會烏震代房知溫為帥，轉增浮說。

translations.literal: When they encamped at Luzutai, Wu Zhen replaced Fang Zhiwen as commander, which further increased loose talk.
translations.idiomatic: At Luzutai camp Wu Zhen replaced Fang Zhiwen as commander and loose talk spread further.

sentences.zh: 震與房知溫博於東寨，日亭午，大噪於營外。

translations.literal: Wu Zhen was gambling with Fang Zhiwen in the east camp; at midday there was a great uproar outside the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen was gambling with Fang Zhiwen in the east camp when at noon a great uproar rose outside.

sentences.zh: 知溫上馬出門，為甲士所擁，且曰：「不與兒郎為主，更何處去？

translations.literal: Fang Zhiwen mounted and went out the gate, was seized by armored soldiers, who said: "If you will not be master for us fellows, where else can you go?
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zhiwen mounted and went out but armored soldiers seized him, saying: "If you will not lead us, where can you go?

sentences.zh: 」知溫紿之曰：「馬軍皆在河西，步卒獨何為也！

translations.literal: 」Fang Zhiwen deceived them, saying: "The horse army is all west of the river—what can foot soldiers alone do!
translations.idiomatic: 」Fang Zhiwen deceived them: "The cavalry are all west of the river—what can foot soldiers do alone!

sentences.zh: 」遂得躍馬登舟，濟於西岸。

translations.literal: 」He then leaped on his horse, boarded a boat, and crossed to the west bank.
translations.idiomatic: 」He leaped on his horse, boarded a boat, and crossed to the west bank.

sentences.zh: 安審通戢騎軍不動，知溫與審通謀，伺便攻之，令亂兵卷甲南行。

translations.literal: An Shengtong held the cavalry army motionless; Fang Zhiwen and Shengtong plotted, watched their chance to attack, and had the mutineers roll up armor and march south.
translations.idiomatic: An Shengtong held the cavalry still; he and Fang Zhiwen plotted, waited their chance, and had the mutineers roll armor and march south.

sentences.zh: 騎軍徐進，部伍嚴整。

translations.literal: The cavalry advanced slowly; ranks were strict and orderly.
translations.idiomatic: The cavalry advanced slowly in strict ranks.

sentences.zh: 叛者相顧失色，列炬宵行，疲於荒澤。

translations.literal: The rebels looked at one another in dismay, marched by torch at night, and were worn out in the wild marshes.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels looked at one another in dismay, marched by torch at night, and were exhausted in the wild marshes.

sentences.zh: 遲明，潛令外州軍別行，知溫等遂擊亂軍，橫屍於野，餘眾復趨舊寨，至則已焚之矣。

translations.literal: At dawn they secretly had the outside armies march separately; Fang Zhiwen and the others then struck the mutineers, corpses lay across the fields, the remainder rushed back to the old camp—and found it already burned.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn outside armies were sent on a separate route; Fang Zhiwen and the others struck the mutineers and corpses filled the fields; survivors rushed to the old camp and found it burned.

sentences.zh: 翌日，盡戮之，脫於叢草溝塍者十無二三，迨夜竄於山谷，稍奔於定州。

translations.literal: The next day they slaughtered them all; fewer than two or three in ten escaped the brush and ditches; by night they fled into valleys and gradually ran to Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next day all were slaughtered; fewer than two or three in ten escaped brush and ditches; by night fugitives fled into valleys and gradually reached Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 及王都之敗，乃無噍類矣。

translations.literal: When Wang Du was defeated, not a mouthful remained.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Du fell, none survived.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，兗州節度使房知溫加侍中，齊州防禦使安審通加檢校太傅，並賞盧台之功也。

translations.literal: On guisi, Yanzhou military commissioner Fang Zhiwen was made Palace Attendant; Qizhou defense commissioner An Shengtong was made acting Grand Tutor—both rewarded for Luzutai.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Fang Zhiwen of Yanzhou became Palace Attendant and An Shengtong of Qizhou acting Grand Tutor—rewards for Luzutai.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，偽吳楊溥遣移署右威衛將軍雷現貢端午禮幣。

translations.literal: On dingyou, false Wu Yang Pu sent acting Right Weiwie Guard general Lei Xian with Dragon Boat Festival tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Yang Pu of false Wu sent acting Right Weiwie Guard general Lei Xian with Dragon Boat Festival tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以前利州節度使張敬詢為雲州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinchou, former Lizhou military commissioner Zhang Jingxun was made Yunzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zhang Jingxun, former Lizhou commissioner, became Yun military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 遣樞密使孔循赴荊南城下，時招討使劉訓有疾故也。

translations.literal: The Privy Council commissioner Kong Xun was sent to Jingnan below the walls—the southern campaign commissioner Liu Xun being ill.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council commissioner Kong Xun was sent below Jingnan's walls because southern campaign commissioner Liu Xun was ill.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以戶部侍郎韓彥惲為秘書監。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Vice Minister of Revenue Han Yanheng was made Director of the Secretariat archives.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Han Yanheng, Vice Minister of Revenue, became Director of the Secretariat archives.

sentences.zh: 是日，幸石敬瑭、安重誨第。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor visited the residences of Shi Jingtang and An Chonghui.
translations.idiomatic: That day Mingzong visited the homes of Shi Jingtang and An Chonghui.

sentences.zh: 丙午，故振武節度使李嗣恩贈太尉，以司封郎中、充樞密院直學士閻至為左諫議大夫充職。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the late Zhenwu military commissioner Li Si'en was posthumously made Grand Marshal; Bureau of Appointments director and Privy Council academician Yan Zhi was made Left Remonstrator at his post.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the late Zhenwu commissioner Li Si'en was posthumously made Grand Marshal; Yan Zhi—Bureau of Appointments director and Privy Council academician—became Left Remonstrator at rank.

sentences.zh: 右諫議大夫梁文矩上言，平蜀已來，軍人剽略到西川人口甚多，骨肉阻隔，恐傷和氣，請許收認。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrator Liang Wenju memorialized: since pacifying Shu, soldiers had plundered many people from western Shu; families were separated and harmony might be harmed—please allow recognition and recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrator Liang Wenju said: since Shu was pacified soldiers had seized many western Shu people; families were split and harmony might suffer—please allow recognition.

sentences.zh: 帝仁慈素深，因文矩之奏，詔河南、河北舊因兵火擄隔者，並從識認。

translations.literal: The Emperor was deeply benevolent by nature; because of Liang Wenju's memorial, an edict allowed those in Henan and Hebei long separated by warfire to be recognized and reclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong was deeply benevolent; on Liang Wenju's memorial he ordered those in Henan and Hebei long separated by war to be recognized and reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是日，郢州進白鵲。

translations.literal: That day Yingzhou presented a white magpie.
translations.idiomatic: That day Yingzhou presented a white magpie.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，以福建留後、檢校太傅、舒州刺史王延鈞為檢校太師、守中書令，充福建節度使、琅琊郡王；

translations.literal: Fifth month, guichou: Fujian deputy regent, acting Grand Preceptor, Shuzhou prefect Wang Yanjun was made acting Grand Mentor, defender Director of the Imperial Secretariat, charged as Fujian military commissioner and Prince of Langya;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the fifth month Wang Yanjun—Fujian deputy regent, acting Grand Preceptor, and Shuzhou prefect—became acting Grand Mentor, defender Secretariat director, Fujian commissioner, and Prince of Langya;

sentences.zh: 以太常卿蕭頃為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Sacrifices Xiao Xiang was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Xiang, Grand Minister of Sacrifices, became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 是日，懷州進白鵲。

translations.literal: That day Huaizhou presented a white magpie.
translations.idiomatic: That day Huaizhou presented a white magpie.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以三司副使、守太子賓客張格卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On wuwu, because Three Agencies deputy commissioner and Defender of Crown Prince Exchanges Zhang Ge died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu court was suspended for the death of Zhang Ge—Three Agencies deputy commissioner and Defender of Crown Prince Exchanges.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、駕部郎中、知制誥竇夢征為中書舍人充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician, Bureau of Chariots director, and edict drafter Dou Mengzheng was made Secretariat drafting officer at his post.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Mengzheng—Hanlin academician, Bureau of Chariots director, and edict drafter—became Secretariat drafting officer at rank.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣宣徽使張延朗調發郡縣糧運赴荊南城下，仍以軍法從事。

translations.literal: On guihai, Palace Secretariat commissioner Zhang Yanlang was sent to levy grain transport from prefectures and counties to Jingnan below the walls, with military law enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Yanlang, Palace Secretariat commissioner, was sent to levy county grain to Jingnan below the walls under military law.

sentences.zh: 以右龍武統軍崔公實為左龍武統軍，以前復州刺史高行周為右龍武統軍。

translations.literal: Right Dragon Martial commander Cui Gongshi was made Left Dragon Martial commander; former Fuzhou prefect Gao Xingzhou was made Right Dragon Martial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Gongshi moved from Right to Left Dragon Martial commander; Gao Xingzhou, former Fu prefect, became Right Dragon Martial commander.

sentences.zh: 割果州屬郡。

translations.literal: Guozhou subordinate prefectures were split off.
translations.idiomatic: Guozhou's subordinate prefectures were detached.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，偽吳楊溥貢新茶。

translations.literal: On yichou, false Wu Yang Pu presented new tea.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yang Pu of false Wu presented new tea.

sentences.zh: 滄州進白鶴。

translations.literal: Cangzhou presented a white crane.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhou presented a white crane.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔罷荊南之師，既而令軍士散掠居民而回。

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict ended the Jingnan campaign; then soldiers were ordered to scatter and plunder residents on the way back.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict ended the Jingnan campaign; soldiers were then told to scatter, plunder civilians, and return.

sentences.zh: 詔：「文武臣僚及諸道節度使、刺史，有父母在者，各與恩澤。

translations.literal: Edict: "Civil and military officials and military commissioners and prefects of every circuit who have parents living shall each receive favor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Civil and military officials and circuit commissioners and prefects with living parents shall each receive favor.

sentences.zh: 」宰臣任圜表辭三司事，乃以樞密院承旨孟鵠充三司副使權判。

translations.literal: 」Chief councilor Ren Yuan memorialized to resign Three Agencies duties; Privy Council herald Meng Hu was made acting Three Agencies deputy commissioner with interim authority.
translations.idiomatic: 」Chief councilor Ren Yuan resigned Three Agencies duties; Privy Council herald Meng Hu became acting Three Agencies deputy commissioner with interim charge.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，華州、邢州進兩歧麥，兗州進三足烏。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renwu: Hua and Xing presented double-headed wheat; Yan presented a three-legged crow.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the sixth month Hua and Xing presented double-headed wheat; Yan presented a three-legged crow.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宰相任圜落平章事，守太子少保。

translations.literal: On bingxu, councilor Ren Yuan was removed from co-equal councilor rank and made Defender of Crown Prince Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Ren Yuan was stripped of co-equal councilor rank and made Defender of Crown Prince Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔天下除並無名額寺院。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict abolished unauthorized monasteries empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict abolished unauthorized monasteries throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使張延朗為右武衛大將軍、判三司，依前宣徽使、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: North Palace Secretariat commissioner Zhang Yanlang was made Right Martial Guard grand general and charged with the Three Agencies, continuing as Palace Secretariat commissioner and acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanlang, North Palace Secretariat commissioner, became Right Martial Guard grand general and charged with the Three Agencies while keeping Palace Secretariat commissioner and acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大理少卿王鬱上言：「凡決極刑，準敕合三覆奏。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Court of Review junior director Wang Yu said: "Whenever capital punishment is decided, by edict there should be three review memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Court of Review junior director Wang Yu said: "Capital sentences by edict require three review memorials.

sentences.zh: 近年已來，全隳此法，伏乞今後決前一日許一覆奏。

translations.literal: In recent years this law has been wholly abandoned; we beg that hereafter one day before execution one review be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the rule has been wholly ignored; we beg that hereafter one review be allowed the day before execution.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，南面招討使、知荊南行府事、襄州節度使、檢校太傅劉訓責授檢校右僕射、守澶州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, southern campaign commissioner, acting chief of the Jingnan expedition, Xiang military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor Liu Xun was degraded to acting Right Vice Director of Works and Defender of Cao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Liu Xun—southern campaign commissioner, Jingnan expedition chief, Xiang commissioner, and acting Grand Preceptor—was degraded to acting Right Vice Director of Works and Defender of Cao prefect.

sentences.zh: 訓南征無功，故有是譴。

translations.literal: Liu Xun's southern campaign had no success—hence the punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xun's southern campaign failed—hence the punishment.

sentences.zh: 詔喪葬之家，送終之禮不得過度。

translations.literal: An edict: households in mourning must not exceed proper funeral rites.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred mourning households from excessive funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 乙未，戶部尚書李鈴上言：「請朝班自四品已上官各許薦令錄兩人，五品官各薦簿尉兩人，功過賞罰，與舉者同之。

translations.literal: On weishan, Minister of Revenue Li Ling said: "We ask that officials from fourth rank up each recommend two magistrates and registrars, fifth-rank officials two clerks and sheriffs each, with reward and punishment shared by the recommender.
translations.idiomatic: On weishan Minister of Revenue Li Ling said: "Let officials from fourth rank up each recommend two magistrates and registrars and fifth-rank officials two clerks and sheriffs each, with reward and punishment shared by the recommender.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: 」An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」An edict approved.

sentences.zh: 其所舉人，仍於官告內標所舉姓名，或有不公，連坐舉主。

translations.literal: Those recommended were to have the recommender's name marked on the commission; on unfairness the recommender was punished jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended men were to have the recommender's name on the commission; on unfairness the recommender was punished with them.

sentences.zh: 仍令三品已上各舉堪任兩使判官者。

translations.literal: Third rank and above were also to recommend men fit to serve as fiscal commissioners' judges.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank and above were also to recommend men fit as fiscal commissioners' judges.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以天策上將軍、湖南節度使、開府儀同三司、檢校太師、守尚書令、楚王馬殷為守太師、尚書令，封楚國王。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Celestial Strategies supreme general, Hunan military commissioner, open-office equal to Three Excellencies, acting Grand Mentor, Defender of Master of Writing, Prince of Chu Ma Yin was made Defender of Grand Mentor and Master of Writing and enfeoffed Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Ma Yin—Celestial Strategies supreme general, Hunan commissioner, open-office equal to Three Excellencies, acting Grand Mentor, Defender of Master of Writing, and Prince of Chu—became Defender of Grand Mentor and Master of Writing and was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸白司馬陂，祭突厥神，從北俗之禮也。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Emperor visited White Horse Ford and sacrificed to the Türkic spirit—following northern custom.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Mingzong visited White Horse Ford and sacrificed to the Türkic spirit—following northern custom.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌朔，以宋州節度使王晏球充北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengxu new moon: Song military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was made deputy northern expedition campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the seventh month of autumn Wang Yanqiu, Song commissioner, became deputy northern expedition campaign commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以左金吾將軍烏昭遠為左衛上將軍，充入蠻國信使。

translations.literal: On guichou, Left Golden Guard general Wu Zhaoyuan was made Left Guard senior general and charged as envoy to enter the Man lands.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wu Zhaoyuan, Left Golden Guard general, became Left Guard senior general and envoy to the Man lands.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「馬殷封楚國王，禮文不載國王之制，請約三公之儀，用竹冊。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "Ma Yin enfeoffed as Prince of Chu—ritual texts record no prince-of-state protocol; please approximate the three dukes' rites and use bamboo registers.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said: "Ma Yin's enfeoffment as Prince of Chu lacks ritual for a state prince; please follow the three dukes' rites with bamboo registers.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，西川節度副大使、知節度事孟知祥加檢校太尉、兼侍中，東川董璋加爵邑。

translations.literal: On renxu, western Shu deputy military commissioner and acting circuit chief Meng Zhixiang was made acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Palace Attendant; eastern Shu Dong Zhang gained added fief.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Meng Zhixiang of western Shu—deputy commissioner and acting circuit chief—became acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Palace Attendant; Dong Zhang of eastern Shu gained added fief.

sentences.zh: 以左效義指揮使元習為資州刺史，右效義指揮使盧密為雅州刺史。

translations.literal: Left Loyal Service commander Yuan Xi was made Zi prefect; Right Loyal Service commander Lu Mi was made Ya prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Xi, Left Loyal Service commander, became Zi prefect; Lu Mi, Right Loyal Service commander, became Ya prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸冷泉宮。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Emperor visited Cold Spring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Mingzong visited Cold Spring Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以檢校工部尚書謝洪為宿州團練使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, acting Minister of Works Xie Hong was made Suzhou training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Xie Hong, acting Minister of Works, became Su training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夔州刺史西方鄴奏，殺敗荊南賊軍，收峽內三州。

translations.literal: Qizhou prefect Xi Fangye memorialized that he had defeated Jingnan rebel troops and recovered the three prefectures within the gorges.
translations.idiomatic: Qizhou prefect Xi Fangye reported defeating Jingnan rebels and recovering the three gorge prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，升夔州為寧江軍，以鄴為節度使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Qizhou was elevated to Ningjiang army; Xi was made military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Qizhou was raised to Ningjiang army and Xi became its military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔曰：「頃因本朝親王，遙領方鎮，遂有副大使知節度事，年代已深，相沿未改。

translations.literal: Edict said: "Recently because this dynasty's imperial princes held distant circuits in name, there came deputy commissioners acting as circuit chiefs—a practice long entrenched and never changed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Because imperial princes long held distant circuits in name, deputy commissioners acting as circuit chiefs became entrenched and were never changed.

sentences.zh: 其東川、西川今後落副大使，隻雲節度使。

translations.literal: Eastern and western Shu hereafter shall drop the deputy commissioner title and simply be called military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern and western Shu shall hereafter drop deputy commissioner and simply be called military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，遂州留後李敬周、鄜州留後劉仲殷並正授本州節度使。

translations.literal: 」On gengwu, Suizhou deputy regent Li Jingzhou and Yanzhou deputy regent Liu Zhongyin were both formally appointed military commissioners of their circuits.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengwu Li Jingzhou of Suizhou and Liu Zhongyin of Yanzhou were both formally appointed commissioners of their circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬申，兗州節度使房知溫移鎮徐州，徐州節度使安元信移鎮襄州，滄州節度使趙在禮移鎮兗州。

translations.literal: On renshen, Yanzhou military commissioner Fang Zhiwen was transferred to Xuzhou; Xuzhou military commissioner An Yuanxin to Xiangzhou; Cangzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Fang Zhiwen of Yanzhou moved to Xu; An Yuanxin of Xu to Xiang; Zhao Zaili of Cang to Yan.

sentences.zh: 以齊州防禦使安審通為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: Qizhou defense commissioner An Shengtong was made Cangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An Shengtong, Qizhou defense commissioner, became Cang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔陵州、合州長流百姓豆盧革、韋說等，宜令逐處刺史監賜自盡，其骨肉並放逐便。

translations.literal: That day an edict: the long-exiled commoners Dou Luge and Wei Shuo of Ling and He prefectures should be ordered to commit suicide under local prefect supervision; their kin were to be exiled as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict ordered long-exiled Dou Luge and Wei Shuo of Ling and He to commit suicide under local prefect supervision and their kin exiled.

sentences.zh: 是日，逐段凝於遼州，劉訓於濮州，溫韜於德州。

translations.literal: That day Duan Ning was exiled to Liaozhou, Liu Xun to Puzhou, and Wen Tao to Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: That day Duan Ning was exiled to Liao, Liu Xun to Pu, and Wen Tao to De.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太子少保任圜上表乞致仕，仍於外地尋醫，詔從之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Defender of Crown Prince Junior Tutor Ren Yuan memorialized to retire and seek physicians outside the capital; an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Ren Yuan, Defender of Crown Prince Junior Tutor, sought retirement and physicians outside the capital; an edict approved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以左金吾大將軍曹廷隱為齊州防禦使。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Left Golden Guard grand general Cao Tingyin was made Qizhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Cao Tingyin, Left Golden Guard grand general, became Qi defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jimao new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以右諫議大夫孔昭序為給事中，以秘書少監崔憓為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Right Remonstrator Kong Zhaoxu was made Regular Attendant; Secretariat junior director Cui Huan was made Right Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Kong Zhaoxu, Right Remonstrator, became Regular Attendant; Cui Huan, Secretariat junior director, became Right Remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以右驍衛大將軍劉衡為左領衛上將軍；

translations.literal: On renwu, Right Valiant Guard grand general Liu Heng was made Left Collar Guard senior general;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Liu Heng, Right Valiant Guard grand general, became Left Collar Guard senior general;

sentences.zh: 以鄴都副留守趙敬怡為右衛上將軍，判興唐府事。

translations.literal: Yedu deputy regent Zhao Jingyi was made Right Guard senior general and charged with Xingtang prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Jingyi, Yedu deputy regent, became Right Guard senior general and charged with Xingtang affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，昆明大鬼主羅殿王、普露靜王九部落，各差使隨牂家清州八郡刺史宋朝化等一百五十三人來朝，進方物，各賜官告、繒采、銀器放還蕃。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the great ghost-lord of Kunming, the king of Luodian, the king of Pulu Jing, and nine tribes each sent envoys with Zangjia Qingzhou's eight-prefecture surveillance commissioner Song Chaohua and 153 others to court, presenting local goods; each was granted a commission, silks, and silver vessels and sent back to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Kunming great ghost-lord, Luodian king, Pulu Jing king, and nine tribes sent envoys with Qingzhou surveillance commissioner Song Chaohua and 153 others to court with tribute; each received a commission, silks, and silver and was sent back.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以御史中丞盧文紀為工部尚書，以左諫議大夫梁文矩為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Censor-in-chief Lu Wenji was made Minister of Works; Left Remonstrator Liang Wenju was made Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Lu Wenji, Censor-in-chief, became Minister of Works; Liang Wenju, Left Remonstrator, became Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 鄧州留後陶玘貶嵐州司馬，以其為內鄉縣令盛歸仁所訟，稅外科率故也。

translations.literal: Dengzhou deputy regent Tao Qi was demoted to Lanzhou aide—for being sued by Neixiang county magistrate Sheng Guiren over levies beyond the tax quota.
translations.idiomatic: Deng deputy regent Tao Qi was demoted to Lan aide after Neixiang magistrate Sheng Guiren sued him for levies beyond the tax quota.

sentences.zh: 仍賜歸仁緋袍魚袋。

translations.literal: Guiren was also granted a crimson robe and fish pouch.
translations.idiomatic: Guiren was also granted a crimson robe and fish pouch.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸皇子從榮第，宣禁中伎樂觀宴；

translations.literal: On guisi, the Emperor visited Prince Congrong's residence and had palace musicians perform a banquet;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Mingzong visited Prince Congrong's residence and had palace musicians perform a banquet;

sentences.zh: 從榮進馬及器幣，帝因以伎樂賜之。

translations.literal: Congrong presented horses and vessels; the Emperor thereupon bestowed the musicians on him.
translations.idiomatic: Congrong presented horses and goods; Mingzong then bestowed the musicians on him.

sentences.zh: 華州上言，渭河泛濫害稼。

translations.literal: Huazhou memorialized that the Wei River had flooded and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou reported the Wei River had flooded and damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以吏部郎中、襲文宣公孔邈為左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Bureau of Personnel director and heir to Duke Wenxuan Kong Miao was made Left Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Kong Miao—Bureau of Personnel director and heir to Duke Wenxuan—became Left Remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 史館修撰趙熙上言：「應內中公事及詔書奏對，應不到中書者，請委內臣一人抄錄，月終送史館。

translations.literal: Historiography compiler Zhao Xi said: "For inner-palace public business and edicts and memorialized responses that do not reach the Secretariat, please have one inner attendant copy them and send them to the Historiography Office at month's end.
translations.idiomatic: Historiography compiler Zhao Xi said: "Inner-palace business and edicts and responses not reaching the Secretariat should be copied by one inner attendant and sent to the Historiography Office monthly.

sentences.zh: 」詔差樞密直學士錄送。

translations.literal: 」An edict assigned a Privy Council academician to record and deliver them.
translations.idiomatic: 」An edict assigned a Privy Council academician to record and deliver them.

sentences.zh: 青州進芝草。

translations.literal: Qingzhou presented lingzhi fungus.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou presented lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 新州奏，契丹乞置互市。

translations.literal: Xinzhou memorialized that the Khitan requested a mutual market.
translations.idiomatic: Xinzhou reported the Khitan requested a mutual market.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，汴州節度使朱守殷加兼侍中，鄆州節度使符習加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On guimao, Bianzhou military commissioner Zhu Shouyin was made concurrent Palace Attendant; Yanzhou military commissioner Fu Xi was made acting Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhu Shouyin of Bianzhou gained concurrent Palace Attendant; Fu Xi of Yanzhou became acting Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，皇子從榮娶鄜州節度使劉仲殷女，是夕禮會，百僚表賀。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Prince Congrong married Yanzhou military commissioner Liu Zhongyin's daughter; that evening the wedding feast was held and the hundred officials congratulated in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Prince Congrong married Liu Zhongyin of Yanzhou's daughter; that evening the wedding feast was held and officials congratulated in memorial.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，義武軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令王都加食邑實封。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinhai: Yiwu army military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Du gained added fief households and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the ninth month Wang Du of Yiwu—acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Secretariat director—gained added fief and enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使趙德鈞加檢校太尉，鎮州節度使王建立加同平章事。

translations.literal: Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was made acting Grand Marshal; Zhenzhou military commissioner Wang Jianli was made co-equal Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou became acting Grand Marshal; Wang Jianli of Zhenzhou became co-equal Chief Councilor.

sentences.zh: 偽吳楊溥遣使以應聖節貢獻。

translations.literal: False Wu Yang Pu sent envoys with tribute for the Sagely Response festival.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Pu of false Wu sent envoys with tribute for the Sagely Response festival.

sentences.zh: 己未，以前雲州節度使高行珪為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiwei, former Yunzhou military commissioner Gao Xinggui was made Dengzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Gao Xinggui, former Yun commissioner, became Deng military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是日，出御劄曰：「歷代帝王，以時巡狩，一則遵於禮制，一則按察方區。

translations.literal: That day an imperial note said: "Emperors of successive ages, at the proper seasons, made inspection tours—on one hand following ritual, on the other examining the regions.
translations.idiomatic: That day an imperial note said: "Successive emperors toured at the proper seasons—both to follow ritual and to examine the regions.

sentences.zh: 矧彼夷門，控茲東夏，當先帝戡平之始，為眇躬殿守之邦，俗尚貞純，兵懷忠勇。

translations.literal: How much more the Gate of Yi, which controls eastern Xia—when the late emperor was pacifying the realm it was the land this petty person guarded as heir; its customs are pure and its soldiers loyal and brave.
translations.idiomatic: How much more Bian, which commands eastern Xia—when the late emperor pacified the realm it was the land I guarded as heir; its customs are pure and its soldiers loyal.

sentences.zh: 自元臣鎮靜，庶事康和，兆民鹹樂於有年，闔境彌堅於望幸，事難違眾，議在省方。

translations.literal: Since worthy ministers have kept it tranquil, affairs are sound and the people rejoice in good years; the whole circuit ever more firmly hopes for an imperial visit—the matter is hard to refuse the multitude, and the plan is to save a journey to the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Since worthy ministers have kept it tranquil affairs are sound and the people rejoice; the whole circuit ever more hopes for a visit—the matter is hard to refuse the multitude, and the plan is to tour the provinces.

sentences.zh: 朕取十月七日親幸汴州。

translations.literal: I shall on the seventh day of the tenth month personally visit Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: I shall on the seventh day of the tenth month personally visit Bian.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，以衛尉卿李延光為大理卿。

translations.literal: 」On gengshen, Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Li Yanguang was made Director of the Court of Review.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengshen Li Yanguang, Minister of Imperial Entertainments, became Director of the Court of Review.

sentences.zh: 北京留守李彥超上言：「先父存審，本姓符氏，蒙武皇賜姓，乞卻還本姓。

translations.literal: Beijing regent Li Yanchao memorialized: "My late father Cunxin's original surname was Fu; the Martial Emperor bestowed the Li surname—I beg to return to the original surname.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing regent Li Yanchao said: "My late father Cunxin was originally surnamed Fu; the Martial Emperor bestowed Li—I beg to restore the original surname.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，夏州節度使李仁福、鳳翔節度使李從嚴、朔方節度使韓洙，並加食邑，改賜功臣。

translations.literal: On yichou, Xia military commissioner Li Renfu, Fengxiang military commissioner Li Congyan, and Shuofang military commissioner Han Zhu all gained added fief and had their merit titles changed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Renfu of Xia, Li Congyan of Fengxiang, and Han Zhu of Shuofang all gained added fief and new merit titles.

sentences.zh: 以汝州防禦使趙延壽為河陽節度使，以比部郎中、知制誥劉讚為中書舍人，以河陽掌書記程遜為比部員外郎、知制誥，以代州刺史李德充為蔚州刺史。

translations.literal: Ruzhou defense commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made Heyang military commissioner; Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter Liu Zan was made Secretariat drafting officer; Heyang secretary Cheng Xun was made Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Dai prefect Li Dechong was made Yu prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanshou, Ru defense commissioner, became Heyang commissioner; Liu Zan, Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter, became Secretariat drafting officer; Cheng Xun, Heyang secretary, became Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Li Dechong of Dai became Yu prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，樞密使孔循兼東都留守。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Secretariat commissioner Kong Xun was additionally made Eastern Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Kong Xun, Secretariat commissioner, also became Eastern Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 襄州夏魯奇上言，荊南高季興遣使持書乞修貢奉，詔魯奇不納。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou's Xia Luqi memorialized that Jingnan's Gao Jixing had sent an envoy with a letter asking to resume tribute; the court ordered Luqi not to accept it.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Luqi of Xiang reported Gao Jixing of Jingnan sought tribute by letter; Mingzong told Luqi to refuse.

sentences.zh: 詔諸州錄事參軍，不得兼使府賓職。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that recorders of the various prefectures must not concurrently hold staff posts in military governors' offices.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred prefectural recorders from also serving as staff in commissionerates.

sentences.zh: 己巳，鄧州節度使史敬鎔加檢校太保，同州節度使盧質加檢校司徒。

translations.literal: On jisi, Dengzhou military commissioner Shi Jingrong was made acting Grand Guardian; Tongzhou military commissioner Lu Zhi was made acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Shi Jingrong of Deng gained acting Grand Guardian; Lu Zhi of Tong gained acting Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 御史台奏：「每遇入閣，舊例隻一員侍御史在龍墀邊祗候，彈奏公事，或有南班失儀，點檢不及。

translations.literal: The Censorate memorialized: "Whenever the Emperor enters the inner court, by old precedent only one attendant censor waited at the dragon terrace to hear official business and impeach;
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate said: "At each inner-court session only one attendant censor waited at the dragon terrace to hear cases;

sentences.zh: 今欲依常朝例，差殿中侍御史二員，押鍾鼓樓位，仍各綴供奉班出入。

translations.literal: if someone in the southern ranks lost decorum, inspection might miss it. We now ask that, following the regular court precedent, two palace censors be assigned to hold the bell-and-drum tower posts and each join the attendance ranks in and out.
translations.idiomatic: southern-rank lapses could be missed. We ask two palace censors, as at regular court, to hold the bell-drum tower posts and march with the attendance ranks.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 以青州節度副使淳於晏為亳州團練使。

translations.literal: Qingzhou deputy military commissioner Chunyu Yan was made Bozhou training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chunyu Yan, Qing deputy commissioner, became Bo training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使梅老沒古已下朝貢。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys led by Mei Laomogu and others to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys led by Mei Laomogu presented tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，西川奏：據黎州狀，雲南使趙和於大渡河南起舍一間，留信物十五籠，並雜箋詩一卷，遞至闕下。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Sichuan reported: according to Lizhou, the Yunnan envoy Zhao He had built a lodge south of the Dadu River, left fifteen cages of tokens and a roll of mixed notes and poems, and forwarded them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Sichuan relayed Lizhou: Yunnan envoy Zhao He built a lodge south of the Dadu, left fifteen cages of gifts and a roll of notes and poems, and sent them to court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯朔，帝御文明殿視朝。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jimao new moon: the Emperor held court at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the tenth month Mingzong held court at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸未，亳州刺史李鄴貶郴州司戶，又貶崖州長流百姓，所在賜自盡。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Bozhou prefect Li Ye was demoted to Chenzhou registrar; then further banished as a commoner to Yazhou in perpetual exile, with orders that wherever he was he be granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Ye, Bo prefect, fell to Chen registrar, then to commoner exile at Ya with orders to grant suicide wherever held.

sentences.zh: 判官樂文紀配祁州，責其違法黷貨也。

translations.literal: His judge Le Wenji was assigned to Qi Prefecture, for illegal conduct and corrupt gain.
translations.idiomatic: Judge Le Wenji went to Qi for illegal conduct and corrupt gain.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，駕發西京，詔留宰相崔協以奉祠祭。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the imperial procession left the Western Capital; an edict left Chancellor Cui Xie to conduct the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Mingzong left the Western Capital and left Cui Xie to conduct the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，帝宿於滎陽。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Emperor lodged at Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Mingzong lodged at Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 汴州朱守殷奏，都指揮使馬彥超謀亂，已處斬訖。

translations.literal: Bianzhou's Zhu Shouyin memorialized that the capital commander Ma Yanqiao had plotted rebellion and had already been executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shouyin of Bian reported capital commander Ma Yanqiao had plotted rebellion and was already executed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，次京水，知朱守殷反，帝親統禁軍倍程前進。

translations.literal: On wuzi, halting at Jingshui, learning that Zhu Shouyin had rebelled, the Emperor personally led the imperial guard and pressed forward at double pace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi at Jingshui, learning Zhu Shouyin had rebelled, Mingzong led the guard forward at double pace.

sentences.zh: 翌日，至汴州，攻其城，拔之，守殷伏誅。

translations.literal: The next day he reached Bianzhou, attacked the city, took it, and Shouyin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he reached Bian, stormed the city, and Shouyin was executed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，磁州刺史藥縱之上言，今月十二日，供奉官王仁鎬至，稱製殺太子少保致仕任圜。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Cizhou prefect Yao Zongshang memorialized that on the twelfth of this month the palace envoy Wang Renhao had arrived, stating by imperial order that the retired Grand Guardian and former crown prince tutor Ren Yuan had been killed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Cizhou's Yao Zongshang reported that on the twelfth palace envoy Wang Renhao arrived with orders that retired Grand Guardian Ren Yuan had been killed.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使持書求碑石，欲為其父表其葬所。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent an envoy with a letter seeking a stele, wishing to mark his father's burial place.
translations.idiomatic: A Khitan envoy sought a stele by letter to mark his father's burial place.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「諸道州府，自同光三年已前所欠秋夏稅租，並主持務局敗闕課利，並沿河舟船折欠，天成元年殘欠夏稅，並特與除放。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict said: "Every circuit and prefecture—autumn and summer tax arrears owed before Tongguang 3, shortfalls in managed offices and market monopolies, losses on river shipping, and summer-tax arrears still owed from Tiancheng 1—are all specially remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict remitted every circuit's pre–Tongguang 3 tax arrears, monopoly shortfalls, river-shipping losses, and Tiancheng 1 summer-tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 時重海既構任圜任圜之禍，恐人非之，思沛恩於眾以掩己過，乃奏曰：「三司積欠約二百萬貫，虛係帳額，請並蠲放。

translations.literal: At the time An Chonghai, having engineered Ren Yuan's ruin, feared public blame and wished to shower favor on the masses to cover his fault, memorialized: "The Three Departments' accumulated arrears are about two million strings, empty ledger entries—please remit them all.
translations.idiomatic: An Chonghai, having framed Ren Yuan, feared blame and sought to win the crowd; he memorialized: "Three Departments arrears of about two million strings are empty ledger entries—remit all.

sentences.zh: 」帝重違其意，故有是詔。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was loath to oppose his intent, and therefore issued this edict.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong would not oppose him, and issued this edict.

sentences.zh: 時議者以蠲隔年之賦，猶或惠民，場院課利一概除之，得不啟奸幸之門乎！

translations.literal: Critics held that remitting taxes of prior years might still benefit the people, but wiping out market-monopoly revenues entirely—would that not open the gate to the crafty and the favored?
translations.idiomatic: Critics said remitting old taxes might help the people, but wiping monopoly revenues entirely would open the gate to favor and fraud.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔曰：「太子少保致仕任圜，早推勳舊，曾委重難，既退免於劇權，俾優閑於外地。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict said: "The retired Grand Guardian Ren Yuan, long honored for merit, was once entrusted with grave affairs; after he withdrew from heavy power he was given ease in the outer provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict said retired Grand Guardian Ren Yuan, long honored for merit, had once held grave affairs and then ease abroad.

sentences.zh: 而乃不遵禮分，潛附守殷，緘題罔避於嫌疑，情旨頗彰於怨望。

translations.literal: Yet he did not observe ritual propriety, secretly attached himself to Shouyin, sealed letters without avoiding suspicion, and his intent plainly showed resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he ignored ritual, secretly backed Shouyin, sealed letters despite suspicion, and his intent showed resentment.

sentences.zh: 自收汴壘，備見蹤由，若務含宏，是孤典憲。

translations.literal: Once Bian's fortifications were taken his tracks were fully seen; if one insisted on forbearance, that would betray the statutes.
translations.idiomatic: After Bian fell his tracks were clear; excessive forbearance would betray the statutes.

sentences.zh: 尚全大體，止罪一身，已令本州私第自盡，其骨肉親情仆使等並皆放罪。

translations.literal: Still honoring the larger principle, only his person was punished—he was ordered to take his own life in his private residence in his home prefecture; his kin, bondsmen, and servants were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring the larger principle, only he was punished—ordered to die at his home prefecture; kin, bondsmen, and servants were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，詔曰：「後來其蘇，動必從於人欲；

translations.literal: " On xinchou, an edict said: "Those who come after will revive; in motion one must follow human desire;
translations.idiomatic: " On xinchou an edict said: "Those who come after will revive; in action follow human desire;

sentences.zh: 天監厥德，靜宜布於國恩。

translations.literal: Heaven watches virtue; in stillness one should spread national grace.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven watches virtue; in stillness spread national grace.

sentences.zh: 近者言幸浚郊，暫離洛邑，蓋逢歲稔，共樂時康。

translations.literal: Lately it was said the Emperor would tour the Jiao suburbs and briefly leave Luoyang—meeting a bountiful year, all rejoiced in the season's peace.
translations.idiomatic: Lately a Jiao tour and brief leave from Luoyang were announced—a bountiful year and shared peace.

sentences.zh: 不謂奸臣，遽彰逆狀，為厲之階既甚，覆宗之禍自貽。

translations.literal: Who expected traitors would so quickly show rebellion; the ladder of harm was already steep, and the calamity of overturning the clan was self-inflicted.
translations.idiomatic: Traitors soon showed rebellion; harm escalated and the clan's ruin was self-inflicted.

sentences.zh: 以致近輔生靈，遘此多端紛擾，永言軫惻，無輟寐興。

translations.literal: So that the people of the nearby provinces met this many-sided turmoil, the Emperor said he could not cease his grief and slept and rose without rest.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby provinces met turmoil; Mingzong said grief would not let him rest.

sentences.zh: 宜覃雨露之恩，式表雲雷之澤，應汴州城內百姓，既經驚動，宜放二年屋稅；

translations.literal: Rain and dew grace should be spread, cloud-and-thunder favor shown: the people within Bianzhou city, having been alarmed, shall have two years' house tax remitted;
translations.idiomatic: Spread rain-and-dew grace: Bian's people, having been alarmed, get two years' house tax remitted;

sentences.zh: 諸處有曾受逆人文字者，隨處焚毀。

translations.literal: wherever anyone had received writings from the rebels, burn them on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: wherever rebel writings were held, burn them on the spot.

sentences.zh: 應天下見禁囚徒，除十惡五逆、殺人放火、劫盜、合造毒藥、官典犯贓、偽行印信、屠牛外，罪無輕重，並從釋放。

translations.literal: All prisoners now held under ban throughout the realm, except the ten abominations and five capital crimes, murder, arson, robbery, compounding poison, official corruption, forging seals, and cattle slaughter, regardless of severity, are all released.
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners under ban, except capital crimes, murder, arson, robbery, poison-making, official corruption, seal forgery, and cattle slaughter, are released regardless of severity.

sentences.zh: 應有民年八十已上及家長者有廢疾者，免一丁差役」云。

translations.literal: Where commoners are eighty or older, or where the head of household has a crippling disability, one corvée laborer is exempted," it said.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners eighty or older and households with a crippled head exempt one corvée hand," it said.

sentences.zh: 以山南西道節度使張筠為西京留守，行京兆尹。

translations.literal: Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Zhang Jun was made Western Capital regent, acting as Jingzhao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun of Shannan West became Western Capital regent, acting Jingzhao prefect.

sentences.zh: 青州節度使霍彥威差人走馬進箭一對，賀誅朱守殷，帝卻賜彥威箭一對。

translations.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner Huo Yanwei sent a man at full gallop to present a pair of arrows congratulating the execution of Zhu Shouyin; the Emperor in turn bestowed Yanwei a pair of arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Yanwei of Qing sent a rider with arrows congratulating Zhu Shouyin's execution; Mingzong returned a pair of arrows.

sentences.zh: 傳箭，番家之符信也，起軍令眾則使之，彥威本非蕃將，以臣傳箭於君，非禮也。
