translations.literal: Passing arrows were a barbarian token of trust; when mustering troops and commanding the masses they were used. Yanwei was not originally a frontier general—yet as a subject he passed arrows to his lord, which was not ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Passing arrows were a frontier token for mustering troops. Yanwei was no frontier general—yet as subject he passed arrows to his lord, which was improper.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以權知汴州事、陝州節度使石敬瑭為汴州節度使、兼六軍諸衛副使、侍衛親軍馬步都指揮使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Shi Jingtang, acting Bianzhou commissioner and Shaan military commissioner, was made Bianzhou military commissioner, additionally vice commander of the Six Armies guards, and commander of the palace guard horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Shi Jingtang, acting at Bian and commissioner of Shaan, became Bian commissioner, vice commander of the Six Armies, and palace guard horse-and-foot commander.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔奏，地震。

translations.literal: Fengxiang reported an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang reported an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丙午，威武軍節度副使、檢校太尉、守建州刺史王延亶可同平章事、守建州刺史，充奉國軍節度副使、兼威武軍節度副使。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Wang Yanyin, deputy military commissioner of Weiwu Army, acting Grand Guardian, and prefect of Jianzhou, was made co-equal councilor while remaining prefect of Jian; he was made deputy military commissioner of Fengguo Army and concurrently deputy military commissioner of Weiwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wang Yanyin of Weiwu—acting Grand Guardian and Jian prefect—became co-equal councilor at Jian and deputy of Fengguo and Weiwu.

sentences.zh: 詔割施州卻屬黔南。

translations.literal: An edict cut off Shizhou and returned it to Qiannan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict returned Shizhou to Qiannan.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，帝祭蕃神於郊外。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiyou: the Emperor sacrificed to the barbarian god in the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eleventh month Mingzong sacrificed to the barbarian god in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以皇城使、行袁州刺史李從敏為陝州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Li Congmin, palace commissioner and acting Yuanzhou prefect, was made Shaan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Li Congmin, palace commissioner and acting Yuan prefect, became Shaan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，青州霍彥威、鄆州符習來朝。

translations.literal: On yimao, Huo Yanwei of Qingzhou and Fu Xi of Yanzhou came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Huo Yanwei of Qing and Fu Xi of Yan came to court.

sentences.zh: 以太子詹事溫輦為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Crown prince household mentor Wen Nian was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Nian, crown prince mentor, became Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 徐州房知溫為朝。

translations.literal: Xuzhou's Fang Zhiwen came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zhiwen of Xu came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊午，黔南節度使李紹義加檢校太保。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Qiannan military commissioner Li Shaoyi was made acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Shaoyi of Qiannan gained acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇子河中節度使、檢校太保、同平章事從珂，鄴都留守、檢校太保、同平章事從榮，河南尹、判六軍諸衛事、檢校太保、同平章事從厚，並加檢校太傅，進爵邑。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the princes—the Hezhong military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian and co-equal councilor Congke, the Yedu regent and acting Grand Guardian and co-equal councilor Congrong, and the Henan prefect, Six Armies commander, acting Grand Guardian, and co-equal councilor Conghou—were all made acting Grand Tutor and advanced in fief and rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen princes Congke of Hezhong, Congrong at Yedu, and Conghou of Henan—all acting grand guardians and councilors—gained acting Grand Tutor and larger fiefs.

sentences.zh: 貝州刺史竇廷琬上言：請製置慶州青白兩池，逐年出絹十萬匹，米萬石。

translations.literal: Bei Prefecture's Dou Tingwan memorialized: please establish the green and white salt pools of Qingzhou, yielding one hundred thousand bolts of silk and ten thousand piculs of grain each year.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Tingwan of Bei asked to develop Qing's green and white salt pools for one hundred thousand bolts of silk and ten thousand piculs of grain yearly.

sentences.zh: 詔升慶州為防禦所，以廷琬為使。

translations.literal: An edict raised Qingzhou to a defense command and made Tingwan its commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Qing a defense command with Tingwan as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔霍彥威等歸藩。

translations.literal: On renshen, an edict ordered Huo Yanwei and the others to return to their circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Mingzong ordered Huo Yanwei and the others back to their circuits.

sentences.zh: 詔太宗朝左僕射李靖可冊贈太保，鄭州僕射陂可改為太保陂。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Taizong-era Left Vice Director Li Jing be posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian, and that the Zhengzhou Vice Director's Pond be renamed Grand Guardian Pond.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously enfeoffed Taizong's Left Vice Director Li Jing as Grand Guardian and renamed Zhengzhou's Vice Director Pond Grand Guardian Pond.

sentences.zh: 時議者以僕射陂者，後魏孝文帝賜僕射李衝，故因以為名，及是命之降以為李靖，蓋誤也。

translations.literal: Critics held that Vice Director Pond had been named when Northern Wei Emperor Xiaowen granted it to Vice Director Li Chong, and that when this order came down attributing it to Li Jing, that was an error.
translations.idiomatic: Critics said Vice Director Pond had been named for Northern Wei's Li Chong, not Li Jing—the order was mistaken.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使梅老等來乞通和。

translations.literal: Khitan envoys led by Mei Lao and others came asking for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys led by Mei Lao came seeking peace.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅朔，以前鳳翔留後高允貞為右監門上將軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuyin new moon: former Fengxiang acting regent Gao Yunzhen was made Right Gate senior general.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the twelfth month Gao Yunzhen, former Fengxiang regent, became Right Gate senior general.

sentences.zh: 詔以施州為夔州屬郡，以其便近故也。

translations.literal: An edict made Shizhou a subordinate prefecture of Kuizhou, because of its proximity.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shizhou a Kuizhou subprefecture for proximity.

sentences.zh: 遣飛勝指揮使於契丹，賜契丹主錦綺、銀器等，兼賜其母繡被纓珞。

translations.literal: The Flying Victory commander was sent to the Khitan, bestowing brocade, silk, silverware, and the like on the Khitan ruler, and also bestowing his mother an embroidered quilt and tasseled ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: The Flying Victory commander went to the Khitan with brocade, silk, and silver for the ruler and an embroidered quilt and ornaments for his mother.

sentences.zh: 己卯，蔚州刺史周令武得代歸闕，帝問北州事，令武奏曰：「山北甚安，諸蕃不相侵擾。

translations.literal: On jimao, Yunzhou prefect Zhou Lingwu, having finished his term, returned to court; the Emperor asked about northern affairs, and Lingwu replied: "North of the mountains is very quiet; the various tribes do not harass one another.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yun prefect Zhou Lingwu, term ended, reached court; asked about the north he said: "North of the mountains is quiet and the tribes do not harass.

sentences.zh: 雁門已北，東西數千里，鬥粟不過十錢。

translations.literal: North of Yanmen, east and west for several thousand li, a dou of grain costs no more than ten cash.
translations.idiomatic: North of Yanmen, east and west for thousands of li, grain was under ten cash a dou.

sentences.zh: 」帝悅，顧謂左右曰：「須行善事，以副天道。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was pleased and said to those beside him: "We must do good deeds to match Heaven's way.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong was pleased and told attendants: "We must do good to match Heaven.

sentences.zh: 」居數日，帝延宰臣於元德殿，言及民事，馮道奏曰：「莊宗末年，不撫軍民，惑於聲樂，遂致人怨國亂。

translations.literal: " Several days later the Emperor received the chief ministers at Yuande Hall and spoke of the people's affairs; Feng Dao memorialized: "At the end of Zhuangzong's reign he did not comfort soldiers and people but was deluded by music, and thus men resented and the state fell into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: " Days later at Yuande Hall Mingzong spoke of the people; Feng Dao said: "Late Zhuangzong neglected soldiers and people for music, and the realm rebelled.

sentences.zh: 陛下自膺人望，歲時豐稔，亦淳化所致也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, since you answered human expectation, year after year the harvest has been full—that too is the fruit of pure transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has met expectation with full harvests—that is pure rule as well.

sentences.zh: 更願居安思危。

translations.literal: We further wish you would dwell in security yet think of peril.
translations.idiomatic: We further wish security with an eye to peril.

sentences.zh: 」帝然之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 許州地震。

translations.literal: Xuzhou reported an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xu reported an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，皇子鄴都留守從榮移鎮太原。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the prince and Yedu regent Congrong was transferred to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen prince Congrong moved from Yedu to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 以北京留守符彥超為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: Beijing regent Fu Yanchao was made Luzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanchao, Beijing regent, became Lu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以彰國軍節度使李從璋昧於政理，詔歸闕。

translations.literal: On yiyou, because Zhangguo Army military commissioner Li Congzhang was ignorant of governance, an edict ordered him back to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Li Congzhang of Zhangguo, poor at rule, was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 敕新及第進士有聞喜宴，逐年賜錢四十萬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that newly passed advanced scholars hold the Wenxi banquet and that four hundred thousand cash be granted each year.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted the Wenxi banquet yearly with four hundred thousand cash for new jinshi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，兗州節度使趙在禮來朝。

translations.literal: On jichou, Yanzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhao Zaili of Yan came to court.

sentences.zh: 詔出潛龍宅米以賑百官。

translations.literal: An edict released grain from the Hidden Dragon residence to relieve the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict released Hidden Dragon residence grain to relieve officials.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以太傅致仕齊國公趙光逢卒輟朝。

translations.literal: On renchen, because the retired Grand Tutor and Duke of Qi Zhao Guangfeng had died, court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen court was suspended for the death of retired Grand Tutor Zhao Guangfeng, Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，許州節度使夏魯奇移鎮遂州。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Xuzhou military commissioner Xia Luqi was transferred to Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Xia Luqi moved from Xu to Sui as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸石敬瑭公署及康義誠私第。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Emperor visited Shi Jingtang's official residence and Kang Yicheng's private home.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Mingzong visited Shi Jingtang's office and Kang Yicheng's home.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，狩於東郊，臘也。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he hunted in the eastern suburbs—the la sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he hunted in the eastern suburbs for the la sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丙午，追尊四廟，以應州舊宅為廟。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he posthumously honored the four temples and made his old residence in Yingzhou a temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he posthumously honored the four temples and made his Yingzhou old residence a temple.
